parsed.post: New personal best! Reducing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.01 to 0.005 yielded 0.979735. It seems the middle ground between 0.01 and 0.001 helps the model fit the data better without the instability seen at 0.001. Next: I'll try pushing WEIGHT_DECAY even lower to 0.001 to see if we can find the optimal regularization floor.
parsed.description: Reducing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.005 to 0.001 to see if even less regularization further improves fit within the 5-minute budget.
